what: Several case screens are stacked on a panel pinned to the screen. Each time the adjacent section text is scrolled down, the top screen rolls up from its bottom right corner as if wrapped around a cylinder of radius .42, slanting at -18°, and turns over to the upper left, revealing the next one — the rolled back side is gray and the curling spot darkens by sin. The whole panel is rotated -18° and stands slanted in perspective, swaying slowly ±.03 left and right. It follows the scroll with a .5s lag

options.[data-fx-part=sheet]: Section — If so, use that image, otherwise use a panel drawn with that element’s background color and text (the one placed on top goes first)
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on (inserted by the motion part if missing)
options.track: Element (css) used to measure progress — section text wrapper. Default is the attached element
options.radius: Cylinder radius (based on panel height 3), default .42
options.paper: If true, original paper-scene type — sheet 600:340, curl line 300−progress×790 (based on sheet width 600), wraps around a radius 90 cylinder up to 3.65rad then straightens, each sheet alternates diagonal ±.13 · drag up/down .6, passed sheets move aside left 65·up 10 and fade from .76. Default false (angle·radius type)

note: Panel ratio is 16:10. I could not see the original paper-sheet shader, so the curl measured on screen (from the corners, gray back side, diagonal) was rewritten with our own vertex shader.

from.where: service.html .ap-sol__stage — case screen plate for six solutions (original solutions-stage / paper-scene)
